title: Find the maximum sum subarray of size k (fixed-size sliding window)
hint: Compute the first window sum, then slide by adding the new element and subtracting the one leaving, tracking the maximum.

title: Find the smallest subarray with a sum greater than or equal to a target (variable-size window)
hint: Expand the right end adding to the sum, and while the sum meets the target shrink from the left, recording the minimum window length.

title: Find all triplets in an array that sum to zero (3Sum), using sorting + two pointers
hint: Sort the array, fix one element, then use two pointers on the remainder moving inward, skipping duplicates to avoid repeated triplets.
